body.p: Use tags to capture a specific point in history, such as a release. A tag is similar to a branch, but it does not change. You can create tags from the Git History view contextual menu.

To manage tags, use the Show tags action from the Ellipsis menu or from the Git main menu. This action opens a dialog box that lists all tags. You can delete local and pushed tags. For tags that exist only in the local branch, you can push them to the remote repository.
